finding.title: Same-snapshot stablecoin price resolved by record ID instead of quality
finding.fixture: FlowObservation supply USDT=1000 USD and two component_price_usd records at identical effective/available/observed ms 1787520123456, source=fixture, revision=1, provenance.stablecoin_id=2, no economic_event_id. Price a_good=1.001 USD quality=.99; z_bad=.900 USD quality=.10. Reverse only their source_record_id names.
finding.source_derived_current: Both price records survive dedup because their source_record_id differs and economic_event_id is absent; sorted source_record_id iteration overwrites by_metric['component_price_usd'] with z_bad. Selected price=.900 (peg_deviation_bps=-1000); swap IDs and selected price=1.001 (+10 bps).
expected_assertions: Swapping only record IDs must not change selected peg price or aggregate deviation.
Conflicting same-snapshot price rows must be explicitly flagged/quarantined or resolved under documented quality priority, never silently overwritten.
One valid price retains normal peg deviation; supply=1000 and tracked_component_count=1 remain stable.
finding.distinct_from: previously recorded stablecoin supply quality tie, symbol-ID collision, peg denominator, boolean/nonfinite price, BTC conversion, cross-unit dedup and missing-asset fallback

scope: worker-control planner_status only; no Specialist code, private/main, workflows, secrets, schedules, or execution changes
